implementation: All four existing entry points (cloud, direct local, configured local fallback, legacy storage wrapper) require explicit tenant UUID, tenant-filtered existing call proof and current configured recording policy/disclosure admission.
Cloud/local admission is rechecked after awaited encoding and immediately before dispatching the write. A policy change after this admission cannot atomically recall external or filesystem writes.

Teardown refuses missing tenant/failed stub DB context instead of writing disk-only unknown-tenant recordings. Existing standalone stub creation retains the authoritative tenant, rejects conflicting config and verifies supplied campaign ownership without bypass.

Each TTS invocation clears prior receipt/status evidence. Only its matching utterance receipt is exposed after cleanup. Completed transport_played maps to private spoken ledger, completed transmitted maps to transmitted ledger; neither claims human hearing.

Both agent-first and caller-first use the same disclosure-delivered contract. Unknown, failed, interrupted, partial, mismatched or unsupported receipt evidence cannot authorize required-notice retention.

Actual TelephonyMediaGateway + TtsPlayback with synthetic Asterisk adapter receipt is followed by actual configured local RecordingService write; transmitted remains supported and _tts_playout_completed stays false.
fixture_changes: Existing isolated encoding/upload/offload fixtures explicitly stub admission; success disclosure fixtures provide synthetic correlated receipt. Dedicated new tests exercise actual admission and playback methods. Existing assertions retained.

independent_review.finding: authoritative tenant replaced by fallback config tenant
independent_review.resolution: same-owner positive and conflicting config/campaign negatives; read-only rereview found no remaining material defect
independent_review.limits: No actual PostgreSQL RLS, live audio, external storage or legal-consent proof.
independent_review.method: Independent actual-method synthetic red probe and final read-only source/test rereview; no separate full50 rerun or claimed independent test count.

remaining_acceptance: OP07 remains open: approved jurisdiction/customer policy, lawful basis/disclosure/consent wording and named owner are external inputs; engineering proof is not legal certification.
No live handset/provider/PSTN/audio-hearing validation or actual storage-account/RLS acceptance was performed.
Configured recording retention_days expiration/physical deletion and local/S3 lifecycle remain unproven; telemetry cleanup dry-run is not recording retention proof. No new retention engine was added.
Approved deletion/export support procedure, backup retention/restore erasure reconciliation and privacy supplier/hosting facts remain separate plan requirements.
The ledger remains bounded in-memory; restart/eviction loses notice evidence and suppresses required-notice recording.
Failure after authorized external/local write but before metadata commit can still require orphan reconciliation; this slice prevents unbound/unapproved writes, not distributed atomic storage.
Legacy storage callers without a usable tenant-bound DB context now fail closed. Operators must supply canonical context; no automatic tenant inference/backfill is provided.
CP05/CP06/CP09 deferrals and production feature freeze are unchanged.
